sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a long-form article layout with static content: hero/image blocks, headings, body text, and simple previous/next style footer navigation on desktop. There are no visible controls such as hamburger icons, menus, tabs, accordions, search, forms, modal triggers, counters, or load-more affordances. The implied interaction is limited to ordinary hyperlink navigation, which is not part of the provided JavaScript taxonomy. Cross-viewport differences appear to be purely responsive layout changes rather than JS-driven behavior.
